title: L4: flow clone action — whole-definition copy, mandatory new name, no ancestry (ADR-0126 §7.1)
body:
Part of #12150 (Epic: ADR-0126 implementation, v17 line — ships as a 17.x minor, maintainer-ruled). Cut on maintainer instruction 2026-08-25 by PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh`. Contract: **ADR-0126 §7.1** (merged `28b47a93`). Independent of the ledger — cloning is authoring an ordinary sibling, no ledger involvement (amendment ruling 2).

## Deliverable

A **clone action for flows** on the data door, shaped on the landed permission-set clone (`sys-permission-set.object.ts:115-152`, #11513):

- **New machine name mandatory** — the action demands a name that does not exist; ⛔ no same-name clone (the engine's name-keyed flow map makes same-name a silent insertion-order shadow, #11665 §2.2 / #11997).
- **Whole-definition copy** — copy the parsed definition, mutate only `name`/`label`/`status`. ⛔ Never param-list assembly: #11703 measured an enumerated-facet clone silently dropping three of six facets, and a flow has far more facets.
- **No ancestry recorded** — the clone is an ordinary install/org-owned flow with no linkage to its base (amendment ruling 2); ⛔ no provenance column, field, or annotation anywhere.
- References are NOT re-pointed (no reference index exists — ADR §9); the clone calls what the original called. The action's response/UI copy states this plainly.

## Acceptance

- Clone of a packaged exemplar flow carries every facet (test asserts deep-equality of the definition minus `name`/`label`/`status` — the #11703 counter-example as a test).
- Same-name attempt refused loudly with the sanctioned path in the message.
- objectui note: carried-over definition blobs are not editable form fields (#11753 discipline) — renderer half rides L5, not this card.

Refs: ADR-0126 §7.1, §9 · #11513 / #11703 / #11753 · #11997
